text: 854 adds kvstore-gtest to the Thunderbird Rust gtest dependency list, lockfile and lib.rs. The dependency points to the Gecko source tree. This is human integration work, not an automated bulk vendor import. The current extern crate kvstore_gtest as _ keeps a deliberate link dependency without a local identifier. No Cargo build or linked gtest execution was performed.
title: Wire a Gecko Rust test crate through each owned integration layer
